version.description: The version of the configuration file.

targetDotNetVersion.description: The target .NET version for generated code.

testProjectName.description: Test project name. Use {ProjectName} as a placeholder.

useFluentAssertions.description: Whether to use FluentAssertions for assertions.

useAutoFixture.description: Whether to use AutoFixture to generate test data.

verbosePrompt.description: Adds extended mode-specific explanations and examples to the AI prompt. Disable for small local models.

useFileScopedNamespace.description: Use C# file-scoped namespaces instead of traditional blocks.

useAsyncSuffix.description: Require the 'Async' suffix for asynchronous methods.

splitTestsByMethod.description: Split tests into separate files based on the method.

maxTestsPerClass.description: Maximum number of test methods per generated class.

aiConfiguration.description: Connection settings for the OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (local server or hosted API).

baseUrl.description: Absolute URL of the OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Must end with '/'. Defaults to a local server on port 8080. Examples: 'http://localhost:11434/' (Ollama), 'https://api.openai.com/'.

model.description: The AI model to use (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet, llama3.1). Ignored by some local servers.

temperature.description: Model creativity (0.0 = deterministic; higher values = more creative).

timeoutMinutes.description: HTTP request timeout in minutes. Defaults to 5.

systemPrompt.description: The system prompt that defines the AI role and rules. Optional.

apiKey.description: Inline API key. Mutually exclusive with apiKeyEnvVar. Do not commit secrets to version control.

apiKeyEnvVar.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key. Mutually exclusive with apiKey. Recommended for cloud endpoints.

oneOf.title: Inline API key
oneOf.description: API key provided directly in the file (e.g. for local servers requiring a token).

oneOf.title: API key from environment variable
oneOf.description: API key is read from the named environment variable (recommended for hosted APIs).

oneOf.title: No API key
oneOf.description: Anonymous access – omit both apiKey and apiKeyEnvVar (typical for local endpoints without authentication).
